title: Record the ten-term COPY cost
body:
## Summary
- The published two-sided extension has ten terms, both factor ranks 9, and no proportional factors on either side.
- Its COPY cost is 72, and the ten products equal the root Gram divided by 18. The bound `9 * (10 - 1 - 1)` is the same 72.
- No new kappa. The 130,305 character pairs stay uncounted.
